description.en: A tower of white stone rises from the Alexandrian harbor, turning royal ambition into a light that sailors can trust.
description.zh: 白石高塔矗立于亚历山大港口，将王权的野心化作水手可以信赖的灯火。

description.en: The rebuilt dome gathers gold, marble, incense, and imperial memory beneath a vault that seems to float.
description.zh: 重建的穹顶收拢黄金、大理石、香烟与帝国记忆，仿佛悬浮于尘世之上。

description.en: A golden dome crowns the sacred platform of Jerusalem, binding pilgrimage, sovereignty, and contested memory.
description.zh: 金色穹顶覆盖耶路撒冷圣台，将朝觐、主权与纷争记忆紧密相连。

description.en: Five towers rise above galleries and moats, making the king's temple a stone diagram of cosmic order.
description.zh: 五座塔尖越过回廊与护城河，使国王的神庙成为宇宙秩序的石质图谱。

title.zh: 继承的最终建筑本地效果

description.en: White walls and red halls climb the hill above Lhasa, turning elevation into sacred administration.
description.zh: 白墙与红殿攀上拉萨山丘，将高处本身化为神圣的治理秩序。

description.en: Muqarnas ceilings, water courts, and red walls preserve a courtly world at the edge of surrender.
description.zh: 蜂巢穹顶、水庭与红墙保存着一个走到投降边缘的宫廷世界。

description.en: Stone terraces and temples cling to the cloud forest ridge, a royal retreat balanced between mountain and sky.
description.zh: 石质梯田与神庙依附云林山脊，一座皇家居所悬置于山与天之间。

description.en: White plaster keeps, layered gates, and twisting approaches turn grace into defense.
description.zh: 白灰天守、重重城门与曲折通路，将优雅本身转化为防御。

title.zh: 继承的最终建筑本地效果

description.en: White marble answers grief with symmetry, gardens, river light, and a tomb made for imperial memory.
description.zh: 白色大理石以对称、花园、河光与陵寝回应哀悼，保存帝国的记忆。

description.en: A disciplined palace axis orders gates, halls, courts, and bureaucracy around the person of the emperor.
description.zh: 严整的宫城中轴将城门、殿宇、庭院与百官秩序环绕于皇帝一身。

description.en: Courtyards, gates, treasuries, and sea views turn conquest into a daily choreography of rule.
description.zh: 庭院、门阙、珍宝库与海景将征服转化为日复一日的统治仪程。

description.en: A great basilica rises over the apostolic tomb, gathering pilgrims, cardinals, artists, and sovereign claims.
description.zh: 宏伟圣堂覆于宗徒墓上，汇聚朝圣者、枢机、艺术家与主权宣称。

description.en: Churches cut downward from living rock make a new Jerusalem in the Ethiopian highlands.
description.zh: 从整块岩石向下凿出的教堂，在埃塞俄比亚高地塑造出新的耶路撒冷。

description.en: Docks, ropewalks, foundries, and guarded basins make shipbuilding a state secret and a civic ritual.
description.zh: 船坞、绳场、铸坊与戒备水域使造船成为国家秘密与城邦仪式。

title.zh: 继承的最终建筑本地效果

description.en: Monsoon routes, warehouses, translators, and merchant law turn a strait into a world market.
description.zh: 季风航线、货栈、译员与商法将一处海峡化为世界市场。

title.zh: 继承的最终建筑本地效果

description.en: Red sandstone walls enclose marble halls, gardens, and a throne room for imperial display.
description.zh: 红砂岩城墙围合大理石殿堂、花园与展示帝国威仪的御座厅。

title.zh: 继承的最终建筑本地效果

description.en: A palace, gardens, mirrors, and ceremony draw the nobility into the orbit of a single sun.
description.zh: 宫殿、花园、镜厅与仪典把贵族吸入一轮太阳的轨道。

description.en: Causeways, canals, aqueducts, and island districts bind the lake city to markets, temples, and war.
description.zh: 堤道、运河、水渠与岛上城区把湖中城市连接到市场、神庙与战争。

title.zh: 继承的最终建筑本地效果

description.en: Concentric canals, quays, warehouses, and counting houses turn a marsh city into a financial engine.
description.zh: 同心运河、码头、仓库与账房把沼泽城市改造成金融机器。

title.zh: 继承的最终建筑本地效果

description.en: Arcades, courtyards, and pilgrim routes expand around the Kaaba, making sacred space hold a world of believers.
description.zh: 回廊、庭院与朝觐道路围绕克尔白扩展，使圣域容纳一个信众世界。

description.en: Walls, passes, garrisons, beacon towers, and border towns turn frontier anxiety into masonry and smoke.
description.zh: 城墙、关隘、军镇、烽燧与边城把边患焦虑化作砖石与烟火。

title.zh: 继承的最终建筑本地效果

description.en: Ledgers, state debts, merchant syndicates, and fortified counters make public credit into an institution.
description.zh: 账簿、国债、商人集团与坚固柜台把公共信用变成制度。

description.en: Earthen pyramids, plazas, palisades, and solar alignments make a river city into a ceremonial center.
description.zh: 土丘金字塔、广场、木栅与太阳方位把河畔城市塑造成礼仪中心。

title.zh: 继承的最终建筑本地效果

description.en: Dry-stone walls, conical towers, cattle wealth, and gold routes anchor a highland commercial kingdom.
description.zh: 干砌石墙、锥形塔、牛群财富与黄金路线支撑起高地商业王国。

title.zh: 继承的最终建筑本地效果

description.en: Mosques, palaces, bazaars, and a polo field frame the capital as a theater of Safavid rule.
description.zh: 清真寺、宫殿、巴扎与马球场把首都构成萨法维统治的剧场。

description.en: Locks, embankments, granaries, and barge routes bind northern courts to southern harvests.
description.zh: 船闸、堤岸、粮仓与漕船航线把北方朝廷同南方粮赋连接起来。

title.zh: 继承的最终建筑本地效果

description.en: Stone roads, rope bridges, tambos, and runners stitch the Andes into a state that can speak across mountains.
description.zh: 石路、索桥、驿站与飞跑信使把安第斯缝合成能穿山传令的国家。

title.zh: 继承的最终建筑本地效果

description.en: Arches march across valleys to feed baths, fountains, mills, and the confidence of an urban empire.
description.zh: 拱券跨过山谷，供养浴场、喷泉、磨坊与城市帝国的自信。

title.zh: 继承的最终建筑本地效果

description.en: Survey lines, desert cuts, Nile branches, and Red Sea harbors preserve the old dream of joining waters.
description.zh: 测线、沙漠河槽、尼罗支流与红海港口保存着连通两水的古老梦想。

title.zh: 继承的最终建筑本地效果

description.en: Brick walls, towers, cathedrals, armories, and palaces compress fortress and sovereignty into one citadel.
description.zh: 砖墙、高塔、教堂、军械库与宫殿把堡垒和主权压缩进同一座城塞。

title.zh: 继承的最终建筑本地效果

description.en: Avenue, pyramids, compounds, and painted walls survive as the plan of a city built for cosmic scale.
description.zh: 大道、金字塔、院落与彩绘墙保存着一座按宇宙尺度规划的城市。

title.zh: 继承的最终建筑本地效果

description.en: Barays, canals, embankments, and rice fields make Angkor's sacred city depend on engineered water.
description.zh: 水库、运河、堤岸与稻田让吴哥圣城依赖被工程化的水。

title.zh: 继承的最终建筑本地效果

description.en: Dikes, pumps, windmills, drainage boards, and reclaimed fields turn the sea into taxable land.
description.zh: 堤坝、水泵、风车、水务委员会与围垦田把海面变成可征税的土地。

title.zh: 继承的最终建筑本地效果

description.en: Retaining walls, drainage, soil layers, and ritual fields make steep mountains feed a royal estate.
description.zh: 挡土墙、排水层、土壤分层与礼仪田地让陡峭山地供养皇家居所。

title.zh: 继承的最终建筑本地效果

description.en: Dockyards, ropewalks, victualling yards, ordnance stores, and officers prepare fleets before war reaches the horizon.
description.zh: 船坞、绳场、补给场、军械库与军官在战云抵达地平线前整备舰队。

title.zh: 继承的最终建筑本地效果

description.en: Convoys, ledgers, fortified ports, and royal warehouses make Atlantic silver move under guard and seal.
description.zh: 护航舰队、账册、设防港口与王家仓库让大西洋白银在封印与护卫下流动。

title.zh: 继承的最终建筑本地效果

description.en: Caravan roads, forts, wells, banners, and imperial subsidies bind pilgrimage to state logistics.
description.zh: 驿路、堡垒、水井、旗帜与帝国补助把朝觐同国家后勤绑在一起。

title.zh: 继承的最终建筑本地效果

description.en: Underground channels, mother wells, shaft lines, gardens, and water shares make desert settlement possible.
description.zh: 地下水道、母井、竖井线、花园与水权份额让沙漠聚落成为可能。

title.zh: 继承的最终建筑本地效果

description.en: Slipways, timber basins, workshops, and treasure ships make river shipbuilding serve oceanic ambition.
description.zh: 船台、木料池、作坊与宝船使江上造船服务于远洋雄心。

title.zh: 继承的最终建筑本地效果

description.en: Walls, shrines, quarters, gates, and processions make one city carry several maps of sacred authority.
description.zh: 城墙、圣所、街区、城门与游行使同一座城市承载多套神圣权威地图。

title.zh: 继承的最终建筑本地效果

description.en: Standing stones, solstice sightlines, and burial memory turn Salisbury Plain into a sacred calendar.
description.zh: 立石、至日准线与墓冢记忆让索尔兹伯里平原成为神圣历法。

title.zh: 继承的最终建筑本地效果

description.en: Keep, wall, river gate, prison, armoury, and jewel house make royal authority visible at London's throat.
description.zh: 主塔、城墙、水门、监狱、军械库与珠宝库把王权显现在伦敦要害处。

title.zh: 继承的最终建筑本地效果

description.en: Gothic vaults, rose windows, flying buttresses, and the Seine make Parisian devotion into a civic center.
description.zh: 哥特拱顶、玫瑰窗、飞扶壁与塞纳河让巴黎虔敬成为城市中心。

title.zh: 继承的最终建筑本地效果

description.en: Clustered chapels, bright domes, processions, and Red Square make Moscow's victory visible as sacred architecture.
description.zh: 成组礼拜堂、彩色洋葱顶、游行与红场让莫斯科胜利成为神圣建筑。

title.zh: 继承的最终建筑本地效果

description.en: Fortified walls, domes, cloisters, scriptoria, and pilgrim roads make the Trinity Lavra a spiritual fortress.
description.zh: 城墙、金顶、回廊、缮写院与朝圣道路让三一修道院成为精神堡垒。

title.zh: 继承的最终建筑本地效果

description.en: River facade, ceremonial halls, guarded galleries, and court ritual turn the Neva capital into an imperial stage.
description.zh: 河岸立面、礼仪大厅、守卫长廊与宫廷仪式让涅瓦首都成为帝国舞台。

description.en: Gates, throne hall, mountain axis, and ritual courtyards make Joseon kingship visible in Hanseong.
description.zh: 宫门、勤政殿、山脉轴线与礼仪庭院让朝鲜王权在汉阳显形。

description.en: Volcanic peak, heavenly lake, forest, altar terrace, and banners make Changbai Mountain a sacred dynastic source.
description.zh: 火山峰、天池、森林、祭坛台地与旗帜让长白山成为神圣王朝源头。

description.en: Walls, bastions, towers, and river gates command the meeting of the Danube and Sava.
description.zh: 城墙、棱堡、高塔与河门控制多瑙河和萨瓦河交汇处。

title.zh: 继承的最终建筑本地效果

description.en: Cliff pillars, suspended chapels, rope hoists, icons, and narrow stairs make Meteora a monastery above ordinary reach.
description.zh: 岩柱、悬空礼拜堂、绳索吊篮、圣像与窄梯让梅黛奥拉成为远离尘世的修道院群。

title.zh: 继承的最终建筑本地效果
